entity: Nebraska's air regulators: formal air enforcement actions filed 2017-2025
why: The headline claims zero formal air actions 2017-2025, but Nebraska DWEE's own enforcement pages show Clean Air Act consent orders inside that window: Green Plains Wood River 2022-02-16 and ADM 2025-10-22. Zero vs at least two is opposite direction on that claim, so Contradicted rules even though EPA's SRF matched the ICIS-Air side (no formal responses in EPA's database, FFY2022). The lead's own watch_out saw this hole.
